title: 15 筋骨共鸣16 内练呼吸
content_zh:
夜。
皎洁的月光洒落。
院子中，传出沉闷的声响。
林哲羽吭哧吭哧锻炼着。
收入上涨后，他每天的伙食得到了改善，在大鱼大肉滋养下，他的身体变得越发壮硕。
林哲羽光着膀子练拳，身上肌肉线条流畅，筋肉皮膜饱满，每一拳挥出，都掀起阵劲风。
足足锻炼了两个小时，林哲羽才停了下来。
【天道酬勤】
姓名：林哲羽
源力：5
技能：蛮牛拳（入门47%）
“源力积累到五单位了，是时候提升实力了。”
林哲羽暗自说道。
这段时间来，他又突破了两次极限，获得两单位源力。
每次突破身体极限后，需要修养五天左右，才能将精气神重新恢复到巅峰。
这十几天来，还了吴管事的五两银子后，林哲羽又积攒到了八两银子，全部被他用来购买药材了。
院子里飘荡着药材的香气。
因为不知道这一次提升需要用到多少能量，他将八副药材都放进去了。
熬到深夜，药材中的药力才全部熬出。
将其倒出、放凉。

咕噜咕噜
药汤喝入腹中，林哲羽舒服地打了个饱嗝。
“使用1单位源力提升蛮牛拳。”
林哲羽传递出念头。
随着他的念头传出，源力消失了1单位。
紧接着蛮牛拳进度开始快速跳动，80%……90%………100%。
蛮牛拳正式晋升到了精通层次，最终卡在了2%的进度上。
熟悉的感觉传来，神秘能量从细胞深处涌出，开始对林哲羽身体肌肉筋膜改造。
林哲羽精神陷入一种奇怪的状态。
他精神来到莫名空间中，在这个空间里，他只有一個念头，那就是练习蛮牛拳！
林哲羽疯狂在这特殊的空间中锻炼着蛮牛拳，一拳又一拳，永不停歇，好不疲倦，犹如疯魔。
在这种神秘的状态中不知道过去了多久，他对于蛮牛拳的体悟越发深刻。
喝入腹中的药汤，在神秘能力的影响下，药力被牵引而出，强化他的体魄。
林哲羽的身体发生着巨大的变化，浑身肌肉变得越发紧实，筋膜强健有力。
片刻后，身体中传出噼啪声响，这是从练肉，进入到锻骨的标志。
蛮牛拳进入精通层次后，就是锻骨境。
几个呼吸后，林哲羽缓缓睁开了眼睛，从恍惚中恢复过来。
他晃了晃脑袋，精神有些疲惫。
content_en:
night.
The bright moonlight shines.
There was a dull sound in the yard.
Lin Zheyu huffed and puffed as he exercised.
After his income increased, his daily meals improved, and his body became stronger and stronger, nourished by big fish and meat.
Lin Zheyu was practicing boxing with his arms bare. The muscles on his body were smooth and the muscles and skin were full. Every time he punched out, there was a strong wind.
After exercising for a full two hours, Lin Zheyu stopped.
【God rewards those who work hard】
Name: Lin Zheyu
Source Power: 5
Skill: Barbarian Bull Fist (47% entry level)
"The source power has accumulated to five units. It's time to increase our strength."
Lin Zheyu said secretly.
During this period of time, he broke through the limit twice more and gained two units of source power.
Every time after breaking through the physical limit, it takes about five days of training to restore the energy and spirit to its peak.
In the past ten days, after repaying Manager Wu's five taels of silver, Lin Zheyu accumulated another eight taels of silver, all of which he used to buy medicinal materials.
The aroma of medicinal herbs wafts in the yard.
Because he didn't know how much energy would be needed for this improvement, he put in eight sets of medicinal materials.
It was only until late at night that all the medicinal power in the medicinal materials was released.
Pour it out and let cool.
GuluGulu
After drinking the medicinal soup, Lin Zheyu burped comfortably.
"Use 1 unit of source power to enhance Barbarian Bull Fist."
Lin Zheyu conveyed his thoughts.
As his thoughts came out, 1 unit of source power disappeared.
Immediately afterwards, the progress of Manniu Fist began to jump rapidly, 80%...90%...100%.
Manniu Fist was officially promoted to the mastery level, and finally got stuck at 2% progress.
A familiar feeling came, and mysterious energy surged out from deep in the cells and began to transform the muscles and fascia of Lin Zheyu's body.
Lin Zheyu fell into a strange mental state.
His spirit came to an inexplicable space. In this space, he had only one thought, and that was to practice Barbarian Bull Fist!
Lin Zheyu frantically practiced the Barbarian Bull Boxing in this special space, punching one punch after another, never stopping, never tired, like a madman.
He didn't know how long had passed in this mysterious state, but his understanding of Barbarian Bull Boxing became more and more profound.
After drinking the medicinal soup in his belly, under the influence of the mysterious ability, the medicinal power was drawn out, strengthening his body.
Lin Zheyu's body has undergone tremendous changes. His muscles have become tighter and his fascia has become stronger.
After a while, a crackling sound came from the body, which was a sign of moving from meat training to bone forging.
After Manniu Fist enters the mastery level, it enters the bone forging realm.
After a few breaths, Lin Zheyu slowly opened his eyes and recovered from his trance.
He shook his head, feeling a little tired.
